newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom could buy CGE cable unit.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom could buy CGE cable unit.

text.p: A France Telecom spokesman said the operator was willing to study an acquisition of the cable network activities of Generale des Eaux.
"We will study any proposal on the basis of several parameters, among which is the price," the spokesman said.

Generale des Eaux chairman Jean-Marie Messier on Thursday said the company would sell its cable activities in the course of the year to a third party and would do so in consultation with the group's media partners Havas and Canal Plus .
He did not exclude a foreign buyer for the activities.
